## More to Explore

## [Projects](/learn-engage/projects)

Butler Gallery works with artists to create projects you can participate in, enjoy and engage with.

![Location Icon](/assets/img/location.png)

## [How to find us](/visit/getting-here)

Butler Gallery is located in the heart of Kilkenny City and is accessible by foot from everywhere in Kilkenny City Centre.

## [Evans’ Home](/heritage/evans-home)

Find out more about the History of Evans' Home.

[Visit Evans’ Home](/heritage/evans-home)

## [Learn & Engage](/learn-engage)

Learn about our collection and exhibitions, have direct contact with artists and enjoy great opportunities to contribute to our creative programme through participation in our pioneering workshops, classes and talks for all ages and interest levels.

## [The O’Malley Collection](/art-and-artists/the-omalley-collection)

The O’Malley Collection includes work from Tony O’Malley (1913 – 2003) and Jane O’Malley (1944-2023).

[Visit The O’Malley Collection](/art-and-artists/the-omalley-collection)

![Clock Icon](/assets/img/coffee_cup.png)

## [The Café](/visit/caf%C3%A9-shop)

Please Note: The café is closed for renovations until further notice. Apologies for any inconvenience.

## [Heritage & Archaeology](/heritage/heritage-archaeology)

Several archaeological digs were carried out from 2010 onwards as part of the Evans' Home refurbishment.

[Visit Heritage & Archaeology](/heritage/heritage-archaeology)

## Become a Friend

Becoming a Friend of Butler Gallery is your opportunity to be part of a world of incredible art and creativity, and to support an organisation that is pivotal to the development of the visual arts in Ireland.

[Join Now](https://www.butlergallery.ie/join-and-give/become-a-friend)

## Art in Your Inbox

Receive our monthly email newsletter and get all the latest Butler Gallery news, including event and exhibition updates.

## Clock Icon Opening Hours

**Monday:** Closed (except Bank Holidays when Sunday hours apply)  
**Tuesday-Saturday:** 10.00–17.00  
**Thursdays:** Late Night 10.00–20.00 (Closed Thursday 12th November 2026)  
**Sunday:** 11.00–17.00  
*Last admission is 30 mins before closing times.*
